name: boss-job-search
description: BOSS直聘求职助手 / 找工作助手 / 找工作工具：多关键词、多城市职位搜索，支持职位采集、岗位采集、岗位筛选、可选完整JD、Excel/CSV/JSON导出、投递记录与求职管理。Windows解压启动的本地求职工具，无需编程；在界面采集岗位、搜集岗位并整理投递清单，也可让AI助手通过命令行收集岗位。BOSS Zhipin job search tool, job scraper, JD exporter & job application tracker.
notes: Preserve established job-seeker entry points when adding natural-language collection synonyms. All existing topics remain. Validate the fixed original-plus-added query set before and after changes; report losses as well as gains. Search-result counts and ranks are not query-volume evidence. Resume preparation uses exported JD as input; no built-in resume rewriting, matching score or automatic application is claimed.
